collections.intro: Explore six visual directions across finish, colour and mood. Every look is a demonstration, illustrated with credited photography and paired with related products.

items.name: Soft Glam
items.summary: A polished, second-skin finish with a diffused glow.
items.imageAlt: Model with a soft natural glam look and dewy skin
items.detail: Soft Glam is the everyday signature: a blurred base, a warm wash of neutral shadow and a skin-like glow. It reads polished on camera and effortless in daylight.
steps: Even the complexion with a light skin tint, blending outward.
Sweep a neutral shadow across the lid and softly into the crease.
Add a touch of highlighter to the high points of the cheekbone.
Finish the lip with a conditioning lip oil in a nude tone.

items.name: Sunset Glam
items.summary: Warm copper and gold tones for a golden-hour flush.
items.imageAlt: Model with warm copper eyeshadow and glowing skin
items.detail: Sunset Glam pulls the golden hour onto the face: copper and gold shadow, a flushed warm cheek and a glossy nude lip. Made for evening light and candlelit rooms.
steps: Press a copper shade across the lid and blend upward.
Layer a gold shimmer on the centre of the lid.
Warm the cheeks with a peach blush.
Line and fill the lips, then add a clear gloss.

items.name: Red Carpet
items.summary: A bold red lip against a clean, sculpted base.
items.imageAlt: Model with a bold classic red lip and sculpted complexion
items.detail: The timeless red-carpet formula: a flawless sculpted base, a defined eye kept quiet, and a precise red lip as the single focal point.
steps: Build a smooth, even base and set the T-zone.
Define the lash line with a coat of volumising mascara.
Trace the lip with a liner for crisp edges.
Fill with a bold red and blot for a lasting finish.

items.name: Dewy Fresh
items.summary: A hydrated, barely-there glow with a tinted lip.
items.imageAlt: Model with a fresh dewy no-makeup look and tinted lips
items.detail: Dewy Fresh is the no-makeup makeup look: hydrated skin, groomed brows, a hint of flush and a soft tinted lip that looks like your own, only brighter.
steps: Hydrate and even with a sheer skin tint only where needed.
Brush the brows upward for a groomed finish.
Dab a cream blush high on the cheek.
Press a lip tint onto the centre of the lips and blend.

items.name: Smoky Night
items.summary: A deep, diffused charcoal eye with a soft lip.
items.imageAlt: Model with a deep smoky charcoal eye and neutral lip
items.detail: Smoky Night keeps the drama on the eyes: a diffused charcoal gradient, tight-lined waterline and a quiet nude lip so the gaze does all the work.
steps: Sweep a matte shade across the lid as a base.
Smudge charcoal into the crease and outer corner.
Tight-line the upper lash line and add mascara.
Keep the lip soft with a conditioning nude oil.

items.name: Editorial
items.imageAlt: Model with a bold high-contrast editorial makeup look
items.detail: The runway statement: graphic lines, sculpted light and an unexpected finish. Editorial is where the house experiments, then distils it into something you can wear.
steps: Sculpt the face with a defined contour and bright highlight.
Draw a clean, graphic line along the eye.
Load the lashes for volume and lift.
Choose one bold focal point and keep the rest refined.

products.name: Weightless Skin Tint
products.imageAlt: Weightless skin tint bottle on a neutral background
products.description: A sheer, buildable tint that blurs imperfections for a second-skin glow.
products.howToUse: Warm between the fingertips and press from the centre of the face outwards.
products.ingredients: Water, cyclopentasiloxane, glycerin, niacinamide, sodium hyaluronate.

products.name: Sunset Eyeshadow Palette
products.description: Twelve warm-to-neutral shades, from matte transition to foiled toppers.
highlights: Mix of matte, satin and metallic
products.howToUse: Sweep transition shades in the crease, then pack deeper tones onto the lid and glow on the inner corner.
products.ingredients: Talc, mica, zinc stearate, dimethicone, iron oxides.

products.name: Liquid Glow Highlighter
products.imageAlt: Liquid highlighter dropper bottle with a luminous finish
products.description: A liquid glow that melts into skin for a lit-from-within finish.
highlights: Blends seamlessly under or over foundation
products.howToUse: Dot onto cheekbones and blend with a fingertip or sponge, alone or over foundation.
products.ingredients: Water, isododecane, glycerin, mica, dimethicone crosspolymer.

products.name: Cloud Blur Blush
products.imageAlt: Cream blush compact in a soft petal pink
products.description: A cloud-soft blurred blush that melts for a natural flush.
highlights: Blurring finish that never looks patchy
products.howToUse: Sweep onto the apples of the cheeks and blend upward toward the temples.
products.ingredients: Talc, mica, nylon-12, zinc stearate, iron oxides.

products.name: Velvet Lip Oil
products.imageAlt: Nude conditioning lip oil in a frosted tube
products.description: A velvet lip oil that conditions with a glossy, non-sticky tint.
products.howToUse: Glide the doe-foot applicator over bare lips or layer over your favourite lip colour.
products.ingredients: Polybutene, hydrogenated polyisobutene, squalane, vitamin E, jojoba oil.

products.name: Precision Lip Liner
products.imageAlt: Rosewood lip liner pencil on a neutral surface
products.description: A precision lip liner that defines and fills for long-lasting colour.
products.howToUse: Outline the lips, then fill towards the centre for long-lasting definition.
products.ingredients: Hydrogenated coconut oil, candelilla wax, isopropyl myristate, iron oxides, tocopherol.

products.name: Lash Volume Mascara
products.imageAlt: Volumising mascara tube with a curved wand
products.description: A volumising mascara that lifts and separates without clumping.
products.howToUse: Wiggle the brush from root to tip and add a second coat for drama.
products.ingredients: Water, beeswax, carnauba wax, acacia senegal gum, iron oxides.

products.name: Glass Lip Gloss
products.imageAlt: High-shine clear lip gloss with a flocked applicator
products.description: A high-shine glass gloss with a cushiony, non-sticky feel.
products.howToUse: Sweep over bare lips or layer in the centre for a plumped, glass-like finish.
products.ingredients: Polyisobutene, squalane, hydrogenated polyisobutene, vitamin E, mica.

story.title: Beauty, designed as a ritual.
story.description: LUMIÈRE is an imagined beauty house built around one idea: a great look is not a product, it is a complete ritual you can repeat.
story.imageAlt: Makeup artist working on a model backstage
paragraphs: We start with the look, then work backwards to the few products it truly needs. Every formula is chosen for how it behaves on real skin, in real light.
This demonstration pairs an editorial identity with a lookbook of visual directions. The photographs belong to their credited creators; they do not document a LUMIÈRE studio or products for sale.
